component.name: Fauste Player
component.summary: Radio playout with several players and a cartwall
Emisión de radio con varios reproductores y una cartuchera

description.p: Fauste Player puts music, jingles and spots on air. Several independent players run side by side, each with its own playlists, and tracks mix sample-accurately at their MIX points.

ul.li: Automatic cue, MIX and outro markers from background analysis
Pre-listen on a separate CUE output
A cartwall of instant carts with pages, loops and exclusive carts
Keeps timing when an output device is lost, and recovers after a crash without putting anything on air
